LanguageData.RM_Acoustic_SettingEffectsTip: Cosmetic only. The reading is the same either way.

LanguageData.RM_Acoustic_Disabled: Acoustic sounding is switched off in Mod Settings.
LanguageData.RM_Acoustic_NotOnShip: The sounder must stand on the substructure of a landed gravship.
